connector.name: YouTube Shorts Agent
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first YouTube Shorts uploader: dry-run validation, OAuth checks, synthetic-media metadata.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package youtube-shorts-agent. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: YOUTUBE_DRY_RUN
env.description: Set to false only when the agent should perform live YouTube upload operations. Defaults to dry-run behavior.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth client ID. Optional until OAuth or live upload flows are used.

env.name: YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google OAuth client secret. Keep local and do not expose it to agents.
